description: A hound cracked open by its own fire. Embers sift from its seams, and its howl smells of burning.
lore: A drover on the west road watched one for eight nights from his fire, then went down and walked it into the river. It let him. That is the part he tells badly every time and the part that costs him his sleep: a lean black dog standing chest-deep in cold water while a stranger poured more of it over the split seams along its ribs — steaming, patient, entirely willing — and the orange in the splits never dimmed by a shade. Then it came out, shook itself, and followed him up the bank.

So he walked to [[characters/646b922c|Sigrun]]'s door and asked her to release it. She went and looked at it for an afternoon, which is more than she gives most requests, and came back and said no, and gave him the reason in the two flat words of [[lore/the_hard_pieces|her trade]]. She cracks shapes that are thinning. This one is not thinning. It is holding beautifully — flame at the tail, fire between the ears, embers going out one by one on the ground behind it, every bit of it as steady as the day it arrived. What he wanted done would have been done for him, and she does not do that work for the watcher. She told him to stay off the road after dark. He goes. He reports that it waits for him at the same bend now, at the same distance, burning quietly, and that he talks to it. She has stopped telling him not to.
gm_notes: Shipped description adopted verbatim; 'cracked open by its own fire' is loose usage of the trade word, and the record turns that into the point rather than fighting it. Art is a lean domestic dog, not a wolf: fissures along the ribs and legs, flame at the tail-tip and between the ears, teeth bared, no muscle on it. Sigrun's refusal is the second half of her tree_stump refusal seen from the other side — there she would not crack a thing that holds on, here she will not crack a thing that holds well, and both are her saying the mercy is usually for the person asking. Nothing has ever been established about whether the burning hurts it, and the record must not settle that. No stone or leavings bound yet.
